one_liner: Customer messaging, support inbox, and Fin AI helpdesk platform

evidence.claim: API supports both Access Tokens (private apps) and OAuth (public apps) for authentication
evidence.quote: An Access Token is for if you're using the API to access data in your own Intercom workspace

evidence.claim: Access Token provided immediately upon app creation for self-serve development
evidence.quote: We provide you with an Access Token as soon as you create an app on your workspace

evidence.claim: Tokens are used as Bearer tokens in Authorization header
evidence.quote: provide it as an`Authorization:Bearer` header in your requests

evidence.claim: Official hosted MCP server available with OAuth or Bearer token authentication
evidence.quote: Intercom hosts a remote MCP server that follows the authenticated remote MCP specification

evidence.claim: MCP server exposes 13 tools for interacting with Intercom API
evidence.quote: The Intercom MCP Server provides **13 tools** for interacting with the Intercom API

evidence.claim: Free development workspace available for building public apps
evidence.quote: To develop a public app you will need to use a development workspace: sign up here to create your free account

notes: OAuth required for public apps accessing other workspaces; Access Tokens sufficient for private workspace automation. Regional endpoints available (US/EU/AU) with separate MCP servers per region.
